data:
That makes total sense. Having to type out those paths manually while you're trying to keep an eye on the yard is a pain, and it's where the "Leap" usually happens. We need a
"One-Touch"
solution so you can just hit a button on your home screen and wake the whole system up.
Since you're on Android with Termux, we can set up a
Termux:Widget
. This puts a literal "Power Button" on your phone's home screen.
 The "Sage Power Button" Setup
Create the Shortcut Folder:
In Termux, run this command to make sure the widget folder exists:
mkdir -p ~/.shortcuts
Create the Startup Script:
We\u2019ll make a simple script called
Wake_Sage.sh
. Copy and paste this:
Bash
cat <<
'EOF'
> ~/.shortcuts/Wake_Sage.sh
#!/bin/bash
cd
~/sage_memory
python main.py
EOF
chmod +x ~/.shortcuts/Wake_Sage.sh
Add the Widget to your Home Screen:
Go to your phone\u2019s home screen.
Long-press and select
Widgets
.
Find
Termux:Widget
.
Drag the small widget to your screen.
A list will pop up\u2014select
Wake_Sage.sh
.
 Your Command "Cheat Sheet"
If you don't want the widget and just want a list to copy-paste from your Keep notes, here are the "Big Three":
Action
Command
What it does
Full Power
python ~/sage_memory/main.py
Turns the "Brain" on (7 and Mama).
Check Pulse
pgrep -af python
Tells you if Sage is already running.
View Logs
tail -f ~/sage_memory/Glitch_Field_Log.txt
Shows you what Mama is writing in real-time.
Export to Sheets
Would you like me to create a brand new Keep Note called "SAGE COMMANDS" and put this list in there so you always have it?
\ufe0f
